description: Branch R-FMT-1 indexes (public side) on an ACCDB. T(ID Long primary key, A, B, C, D, E Long): indexes Z_ix, M_ix, a_ix, B_ix, _first and 0_ix are created in that order, each by its own statement, and the index list (names, Primary, Unique, Foreign, fields) is read after every creation, again after Indexes.Refresh, and after a read-only reopen. Asks whether TableDef.Indexes enumerates in name order or creation order, and how case, an underscore and a digit sort.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
